prisma_user.evidence: Referenced only as a grant recipient: GRANT ALL on schema public, ~30 public tables/sequences, and default privileges of role postgres in schema public (33 GRANT lines + 2 ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES). Owns nothing in the dump, appears in no policy, function or view, and no code in this repository refers to it. Source attributes: NOSUPERUSER INHERIT NOCREATEROLE NOCREATEDB LOGIN NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS; membership GRANT prisma_user TO postgres WITH ADMIN OPTION, INHERIT FALSE, SET FALSE.
prisma_user.deviation: LOGIN is not reproduced: the source password is not exported and an isolated target needs no external login. All grants, default privileges and the postgres membership are reproduced exactly.
